data.title: Oral Sentence Studio
data.description: Use both new words in one complete sentence of your own.

wordMeanings: shining with a lot of light
challenges.sceneMeaning: The bright sun shines while the hungry bunny finds a fresh carrot in the garden.
acceptedSentences: I can see a bright star in the sky and eat a fresh apple.
The bright yellow flower grows next to some fresh green grass.
A bright bird sings a song near the fresh water puddle.
challenges.storyText: The bright sun shines on the garden today. A cute bunny finds a fresh orange carrot to eat.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The quiet girl reads many smart books at the classroom table.
acceptedSentences: That quiet dog looks very smart when it sits.
A smart turtle walked across the quiet path outside.
We must be quiet so the smart bird can sing.
challenges.storyText: The girl sits in the quiet room. She reads a smart book about animals.

challenges.sceneMeaning: The swift girl ran across the park while feeling joyful with her red ball.
acceptedSentences: The swift puppy ran across the green grass and felt joyful.
A joyful bird flew past the tall tree in a swift way.
Swift little frogs jumped in the pond and looked very joyful.
challenges.storyText: The swift girl ran through the green park. She chased the red ball and felt joyful.
